A valid token that the resource server must refuse — for example one issued to a client the server does not serve — has no way to reach the 403 that the MCP authorization spec asks for. This adds `auth.ErrForbidden`: when a verifier error unwraps to it, `RequireBearerToken` answers 403

It includes: 1. **`server.json` files** for all 7 local servers (everything, filesystem, memory, sequentialthinking, fetch, git, time) 2. **Version sync** in `release.py` to keep `server.json` versions aligned with package versions 3. **CI automation** to publish server metadata

A notification sent before `initialize` instead gets an error reply under a random id, though notifications never get responses. items.title: fix: accept loopback Host and Origin without a port in OriginValidator.localhost()
items.excerpt: `OriginValidator.localhost()` builds wildcard patterns such as `localhost:*`, and `matchesPattern` requires a `: ` suffix after the host. items.title: Await async workers before stringifying FanOut results
items.excerpt: Fixes #812. `FanOut.generate_str()` currently stringifies an asynchronous worker’s return value before the executor can await it, so callers can receive a coroutine representation without the worker running. This change leaves ordinary synchronous invocation and string conversion on the executor thread, and returns an awaitable projection only for results that need to be awaited. Added focused tests for async workers
